source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5 ("County council election results"); Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1 ("Derry County Council: Dungiven Division")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes as printed: 'J. V. G. Brolly (Nat.) 671; T. M'Sorley (Ind. Nat.) 521. Spoiled votes 15. Poll 71.9 per cent' (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958; the Irish News of the same date prints the same two figures)

note: Polled 5 June 1958 (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958: 'polling will take place on June 5'). Nominations were received on 20 May. Seventeen seats were returned unopposed at nomination. Two contests were nominated, Dungiven and Faughanvale, but polling on 5 June took place only in Dungiven; the Faughanvale poll did not go ahead and John M'Laughlin, who is named as the outgoing member in 1961, was returned (Northern Whig, 6 June 1958, p. 3; Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). The Dungiven result is recorded here. No party labels were printed for the unopposed returns. The outgoing member, Joseph C. M'Laughlin, did not seek re-election.
